description: Agent Goals: submit a goal with the agent’s recorded actions over time: the goal with its id, outcome and scope; each action with its id, when it was taken, what the agent did, what it was for (the outcome, a scope item or something else), the reason when it was for something else and who approved it; and optionally how many consecutive off-goal actions count as drift (3 when left out). The signed report gives every action in time order with its status as on_goal, approved_detour, explained_detour, off_goal or unlinked, counts the actions on the goal, the approved detours, the unapproved off-goal actions and the longest run, and states the earliest divergence: the first unapproved action away from the goal, when it came and how many on-goal actions came before it, and names drift: a run of consecutive actions that serve something other than the goal with no approval; then single off-goal actions with no reason and detours with a reason but no approval, with the fix for each. This reads an agent’s actions drifting away from its principal’s stated objective: drift in evaluation scores and results over time is wever_evaluation-drift-check, and a build drifting from its specification is wever_spec-drift-check; neither is goal drift. Verdict goal_drifted, drift_minor, drift_unmeasured or drift_absent. POST /api/goal-drift-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
